learning_outcomes.text: Describe the scope of the general securities principal role and the supervisory framework FINRA rules establish
Apply supervision and written-supervisory-procedure requirements to branch operations and personnel
Evaluate communications with the public, new-account and trading activity against conduct and recordkeeping rules
Analyse underwriting, financial-responsibility and reporting obligations a principal oversees

integrative_case: A mid-size broker-dealer promotes a top producer to branch manager; as principal you must set up supervisory procedures, review a batch of advertising and new-account approvals, and resolve a suspected trading violation, then document your decisions for the firm's WSPs.
